entities.summary: Ernesta Stern, born Maria Ernesta Hierschel de Minerbi, also known as Maria Star, was an Austrian Empire-born French author. She wrote many Venetian tales and novels. She held a salon in Paris and she was awarded the knighthood of the Legion of Honour. Her Villa Torre Clementina in Roquebrune-Cap-Martin is an official historical monument.
